turn1.text:
Three rivers in Europe are:

1. **Danube** — flows through or along ten countries (Germany, Austria, Slovakia, Hungary, Croatia, Serbia, Bulgaria, Romania, Moldova, and Ukraine) before emptying into the Black Sea.

turn2.text: The **Danube** is the longest of the three, at roughly **2,850 km (1,770 miles)**. It rises in the Black Forest region of southwestern Germany and flows east through Central and Eastern Europe to the Black Sea

turn3.text: The **shortest** of the three is the one I mentioned as the third river — the **Seine**, at about **777 km (483 miles)**. It rises on the Langres Plateau in northeastern France and flows northwest through Paris
